comments.author: netVnum

Hi CrocodileJonesy!

Thanks for the feedback and reporting this issue. I’m not sure whether to be impressed or concerned. It’s easy to avoid for now, and I’ll add this to the main page of the mod so others are aware not to do this

Thanks!

-net
